citations.claim: At first violating step body 0 position/velocity is non-finite (NaN), x is null
System energy is non-finite at the same step
One step before, body sits exactly on final waypoint 3.94894,3.17960 with near-zero speed
Body speed essentially zero while dwelling on waypoint shortly before NaN
Body already settled on final waypoint much earlier, dwelling for ~29 steps before blowup

counterfactual.change: Set controller.enabled true->false (one field); hover vehicle then follows ballistic motion and no NaN occurs over same 1729 steps.

explanation: Hover body reaches and dwells exactly on final waypoint (position equals waypoint, speed ~1e-12) for many steps, then position/velocity and energy become non-finite at step 1729. This pattern indicates controller waypoint logic divides by distance-to-target (normalize zero vector) or similar 0/0 when switching/holding at final waypoint with zero velocity error, producing NaN that poisons integration. Disabling the controller removes the failure.
vision_note: The red violating body sits nearly stationary in the left-mid area through steps 1726 to 1728, far below the green waypoint at the top. At step 1729 the red body abruptly vanishes while the arena and waypoints remain, consistent with its position becoming non-finite. [disagreement: The explanation claims the body dwells exactly on the final waypoint before NaN, but the picture shows a large gap between the body and the waypoint in all pre-violation frames.]
